name: reference.banks

list.description: List native bank reference records; country selects cityCode locally after acquisition.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Exact local cityCode match; repeat for alternative values. Applied after full acquisition in live and cached modes; never sent to the backend.

summary: Bank reference records with exact local country selection.
purpose: Inspect maintained bank reference records and native bank codes without changing bank configuration.

fields.name: cityCode
fields.meaning: Native country/location code used by the local country filter.

identity_description: Native bankId identifies a bank reference record; no synthetic identity is created.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant, native rowStart offsets and pageSize=5000.
Country is an exact case-sensitive local match on cityCode; repeated values select alternatives, without duplicate output.
Native endpoint has no page echoes. Completeness uses fixed total, identity and arrival evidence.
Pinned v0.4.3 contract is historical provenance; current production qualification is recorded separately.

examples.title: Read saved banks for Singapore or United States
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list reference.banks --country SG --country US
